changes: Structures simplified to a triangle budget per part, piece by piece with their open edges kept, positions quantised to 16 bits; stray debris, surface patches and inner spongy bone left out, but the patches that close a hole put back (the femur's lower end, the spleen's diaphragmatic surface, the female liver's bare area); the brain mirrored left to right so each side lies where its name says, and scaled (male 0.92, female 0.91) about a point between the medulla's foot and the optic chiasm so it fits inside the skull; labels and UBERON ids from the crosswalk, corrected where wrong for the mesh (sides swapped on the renal arteries, vas deferens and thymus lobes); the female set's placenta, which sits outside the body, left out. Added: the Visible Human skull, placed by its eyes and upper teeth, kept under the skin, and carried onto the female head by a warp fitted on the head's skin, neck vertebrae, eyes and teeth; ribs, costal cartilages, the male sternum, clavicles, scapulae, humeri, the hip and deep back muscles, thyroid, adrenals, oesophagus and stomach meshed from two TotalSegmentator CT scans and carried into each body by a warp fitted on the structures both have; the rib cage widened smoothly to clear the lungs and liver, the shoulders lowered under the skin, the humeri laid along the arms, and the rest pushed out of the organs and bones they cut into.
